articles.title: Why your feet tell you about heat strain first
articles.deck: Extremities shed heat before core temperature moves. What that means for when you should stop.

sections.text: OUTLINE — needs writing. Explain the physiology of heat dissipation through glabrous skin on the soles, why peripheral blood flow rises before core temperature climbs, and what that means for the timing of a warning. Cite a peer-reviewed thermoregulation source for the mechanism.
PULL-STAT — needs a real figure and its source. The mock used a placeholder number; do not ship one that has not been checked against the original publication.

OUTLINE — needs writing. Describe what Thermyx actually measures: contact temperature at the insole, sampled continuously, and why watching a trend across zones separates a hot boot from a hot body. Be explicit that this is not a core-temperature measurement.
